{{Top|leg}}
'''Space platforms''' were a common type of mass-produced [[Space station/Legends|space stations]]. Available in a variety of sizes and components, space platforms were found all over [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and deployed in a number of roles. Space platforms were employed as defense stations, customs outposts, and roles as varied as repair, communications, training, scientific and commerce duties. Space platforms were analogous to the stock [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] in terms of their adaptability and availability.<ref name="HS">''[[Hideouts & Strongholds]]''</ref>
